payload.set_intro: A researcher invited 50 volunteers to join a discussion club. Volunteers were randomly assigned to one of two entrance procedures. In the easy procedure, they simply signed a form. payload.set_intro: Researchers tested a cognitive therapy for social anxiety. Anxiety was measured with a questionnaire (higher scores mean more anxiety) before and after eight weeks. Participants in the study gave informed consent.
